description: Main FastAPI application code for investment teaser generator backend. Defines endpoints for health check, scraping company info, file uploads, company confirmation, teaser generation, and export.

classes.name: ScrapeResponse
classes.description: Response model for scraping company info, containing company details and success indicator.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response model for uploaded files, including list of UploadedFileInfo objects.

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyResponse
classes.description: Response model for company confirmation, returning session ID.

classes.name: TeaserGenerationResponse
classes.description: Response model for teaser generation, containing teaser content and status.

classes.name: TeaserContent
classes.description: Contains details of the generated teaser such as title, content, company info, and timestamp.

classes.name: ExportResponse
classes.description: Model for teaser export info, including filename and download URL.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Simple health check endpoint returning a status message.

methods.name: scrape_company(req: ScrapeRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint to scrape company information from a provided URL. Currently returns a stub company.

methods.name: upload_files( files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more files to upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX)."), company_id: Optional[UUID] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles file uploads (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX), saves metadata, and returns info about uploaded files.

methods.name: confirm_company( req: ConfirmCompanyRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Accepts user-confirmed or edited company profile, saves it to DB, and returns a session ID.

methods.name: generate_teaser( req: TeaserGenerationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Stub function to generate a teaser draft based on company info, returns a teaser object and status.

methods.name: export_teaser( teaser_id: UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Placeholder for exporting teaser documents, e.g., as PDF.

ctags.name: upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more files to upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX)."), company_id: Optional[UUID] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
